                    resembling this object.

               Dear          Sir:                                                                   e

                                      In response to your                          letter of              September 22, 1958,
                   the following                 requested information                         is furnished:                       _y
                                      The Federal                Bureau of             Investigation does
                             not investigate sightings of unidentified flying
                             objects. When    the details    of such ssighting
                             are reported  to representatives      of this  Bureau,-
                             the information                    is forwarded               to the             Air Force.

                                _ Representatives                         of this          Bureau do
                                                                                                  not                      issue
                             instructions to                    individuals who                  have sighted                   un-
                             identified flying                     objects that                they should                 not
                             talk about                 such sightings.                                          &#39;-
1                                     it is             not
                                                         s       function of               this Bureau                 to make

                         On Uecember l7,    1969                    the     of
                                                                           Secretary               the Air Force      .
                    announced the of
                                  termination                             Project    Blue         Book, the Air  _
                                                                                                                 Force
                    program for            the of
                                               investigation                      UFOs.                                                   i
                          The decision to discontinue       UFO investigations    was based
                    on an of
                           evaluation      a report prepared by the of    University
                    Colorado entitled,     Scientific    of
                                                         Study      Unidentified    Flying
                                a of
                    Objects;&#39;  review    the ofUniversity       Colorado&#39;s
                                                                                 report by
                    the National     of
                                    Academy     Sciences: past UFO studies:        and Air
                    Force       experience            UFO
                                                     investigating                  reports        during           the      past
                    two      decades.                                                                   ;
                                                                                                        &#39;

                          As a ofresult      these investigations      and studies,   and
                    experience gained from UFO   investigating         reports since 1948,
                    the of
                         conclusions        Blue
                                           Project           Book are:     ! no UFO reported,
                    investigated,     and evaluated by the Air Force has ever given
                    any of
                         indication       threat to our rational       security:    ! there
                    has been            no evidence        submitted         to or discovered                  by the          Air
                    Force that sightings    categorized   as "unidentified"   represent
                    technological  developments or principles      beyond the of
                                                                               range
                    present day scientific     knowledge; and ! there has been no
                    evidence indicating    that sightings   categorized    as unidentified
                    are      extraterrestrial              vehicles.

                          with the oftermination      Project Blue Book, the Air Force
                    regulation   establishing    and controlling   the program for invest-
                    igating   and analyzing UFOs was rescinded.        All documentation
                    regarding the former Blue Book investigation          has been per-
                    manently transferred      to the Modern Military    Branch, National
                    Archives and Records Service,      8th and Pennsylvania      &#39;
                                                                                Avenue,
                     D.C.
                    Washington,          20408, and is available     for public review
               - and analysis.

                            Attached for your information  is the Froject Blue Book
                    sighting     summary for the period 1947-1969.   Also included is,
                    a of
                       listing      UFO-related materials  currently  available.
                              Since       the     of
                                                 termination               Project        Blue      Book,          no evidence
                    has been presented to indicate  that                              further    of
                                                                                                inVeStigatiOn
                    UFOs by the Air Force is warranted.                                In of
                                                                                           view      the consider-&#39;
                    able      Air       Force    of
                                                 commitment               resources        in     the    past,          and       the
                    extreme         pressure            Force
                                                     on Air                funds at this              time,         there         is
                    no     Likelihood           OI   renewed-Air          Force     involvement               in    Carea.
